purpose: A compact machine-readable shadow of the human certificate. Read the claims in order; use source_file and check_file fields to recover full evidence.

overview.plain_language: The same sequence is obtained from an ordered three-slot tree model, Lagrange inversion, contour coefficient extraction, an exact matrix reduction, a polynomial recurrence, and a differential equation. The payload names the exact object and check behind each displayed claim.

claims.statement: a(n) counts rooted ordered ternatrees with n true leaves, three ordered child positions at each internal vertex, and no unary branching.
claims.explanation: Deleting empty child positions gives an ordered tree whose internal vertices have two or three children; every binary vertex remembers one of three possible deleted positions.
A nonempty tree is a leaf, a binary internal root with one of three missing slot positions, or a ternary internal root.

claims.statement: The recurrence integrand is the u-derivative of R(n,u)*H_n(u), with R=N/rho and N recorded below.

claims.explanation: The tree specification gives the equation directly; independently, its branch through A(0)=1 satisfies the certified ODE and initial values.

checks.machine_rule: Every check is exact. A pass means the symbolic residual is identically zero or every requested exact integer comparison agrees.

assertions.claim: The pole-lowering identity holds for the declared basis.
